results.question: What does Volkswagen disclose about employee health and safety in 2024?
results.ground_truth: Chapter 1.7 of our Social Charter states in case of Occupational Safety and Health Protection: Volkswagen meets at least the respective national standards for a safe and hygienic working environment and in this context will undertake appropriate measures to assure health and safety in the workplace so that healthy employment conditions are assured.
results.answer:
Volkswagen reports that in 2024 it maintained a Group‑wide occupational health and safety (OHS) policy, provided resources and training (average 18.9 hours per employee), required ISO 45001 certification for sites with >1,000 employees, conducted internal audits and a risk analysis, and set a target to complete all ISO 45001 certifications by 2026.  

The 2024 Sustainability Report states that senior managers must allocate sufficient financial, human and material resources to OHS and ensure qualified staff. A dedicated Group OHS unit handles standards, communication and monitoring. Volkswagen mandated ISO 45001 certification for all production sites with more than 1,000 employees, with internal ISO‑based audits (four Group audits in 2024) and a systematic risk‑analysis using self‑assessment questionnaires. The average training provided to employees was 18.9 hours per year. Completion of the required ISO 45001 certifications across the Group is planned for 2026, underpinning the OHS target.  

- “The average number of training hours per employee … was 18.9 hours.” [Volkswagen's 2024 Sustainability Report, p. 156]  
- “The Group has issued a Group‑wide policy requiring the companies to introduce and obtain certification for an ISO 45001 management system at all production sites with more than 1,000 employees.” [Volkswagen's 2024 Sustainability Report, p. 156]  
- “Four (three) Group audits were conducted in 2024.” [Volkswagen's 2024 Sustainability Report, p. 156]  
- “Completion of the required ISO 45001 certifications by 2026 is planned.” [Volkswagen's 2024 Sustainability Report, p. 156]
